title: Image Smoother
summary: Given an m x n matrix img representing an image in grayscale, apply a 3x3 smoothing filter to each cell.
statement: Given an m x n matrix img representing an image in grayscale, apply a 3x3 smoothing filter to each cell. For each cell, calculate the average of the cell and its eight neighbors, rounding down. If a neighbor is out of bounds, exclude it from the average calculation.
constraints: 1 <= rows, columns <= 200; cell values are from 0 through 255.
Each output cell is the floor of the average of itself and all in-bounds adjacent cells.
hints: Border cells have clipped neighborhoods rather than implicit zero neighbors.
Enumerate the at most nine valid coordinates around each cell.
Clamp row and column ranges, sum their values, and floor-divide by the count.
Every output depends only on the original matrix, so write results into a separate matrix.
editorial: Every output depends only on the original matrix, so write results into a separate matrix.

tests.explanation: Corner neighborhoods average to zero after flooring, as does the nine-cell center neighborhood.
A one-cell image smooths to its own value.
